description_en: Queries the contract information and contract execution status of the current user account on Alibaba Cloud Link WAN
description_zh: 查询当前用户账号在物联网络管理平台的合约信息及合约执行情况
name: GetUserLicense

Data.description_en: The capacity and current usage of each service
Data.description_zh: 各项服务的容量与当前使用量

GatewayCount.description_en:
The usage of the gateway connection service.

Indicates the number of gateways that the current user account has connected
GatewayCount.description_zh:
网关接入服务的用量。

表示当前用户账号已经接入的网关数量

GatewayDingTalkCount.description_en: The usage of the DingTalk gateway connection service
GatewayDingTalkCount.description_zh: 钉钉网关接入服务的用量

GatewayDingTalkLimit.description_en: The capacity of the DingTalk gateway connection service
GatewayDingTalkLimit.description_zh: 钉钉网关接入服务的容量

GatewayFreeLimit.description_en:
The free capacity of the gateway connection service.

Indicates the maximum number of gateways that the current user account can connect for free. This value is always less than or equal to GatewayLimit
GatewayFreeLimit.description_zh:
网关接入服务的免费容量。

表示当前用户账号可以免费接入的网关数量上限，其值必然小于等于 GatewayLimit

GatewayLimit.description_en:
The capacity of the gateway connection service.

Indicates the maximum number of gateways that the current user account can connect
GatewayLimit.description_zh:
网关接入服务的容量。

表示当前用户账号可以接入的网关数量上限

GatewayPrePayCount.description_zh:

GatewayProfessionalCount.description_en: The capacity of the professional gateway connection service
GatewayProfessionalCount.description_zh: 专业网关接入服务的容量
